title: Men's Soccer: The Whole Road to College
title_html:
Men's Soccer:
The Whole Road to College
rules_checked: 11 November 2026, against the NCAA rule text, the printed Division I calendar, the NAIA handbook and the NJCAA procedures chart
levels: D1 and D2 and D3 and NAIA and junior college
kicker: Soccer · boys and men · grades 9 to 12 · sport playbook
sub: What to do, when to do it, who pays, and what a coach is and is not allowed to tell you. Built from the 2026-27 NCAA rule text, the printed Division I recruiting calendar, the NAIA and junior college rule books, and the league structures a family is already paying into.
edge: About 485,000 boys play high school soccer and 28,746 play it in the NCAA, which is 5.9 percent. In this sport the rule book decides when a coach may answer, and a 28-player roster limit decides how many of the boys already on a college roster can be joined by a new one. Both are free to know before a family pays $404 for a showcase day, fee included. That price is one seller's, not ours: $379 for two sessions and a $25 sign-up fee.
